# Data Downloads

**Updated October 15, 2026.** Both datasets have 160 districts observed for seven
years (1,120 rows each). They are synthetic education-policy examples with no
adjustment covariates. They replace the earlier 11-year workshop datasets.

**Data correction:** Simulation 2 now has two treated cohorts, adopting in Years
5 and 6, plus never-treated districts. Year 7 is a follow-up year, not an adoption
cohort. Simulation 1 is unchanged. The Workshop walkthrough, code, figures, and
downloadable model results now use this corrected design. The lecture slides
are a separate working draft.

Both outcome columns represent the same outcome: `outcome_raw = 50 + 10 * outcome_std`.
The lab uses raw score points for graphs and models. The standardized column uses a
common pre-treatment reference scale, not separate standardization by group or year.
These continuous synthetic scores have no fixed minimum or maximum.

| Dataset | Purpose | Downloads |
|---|---|---|
| `simple_did_district` | 80 districts adopt in Year 5; 80 never treated. Constant treatment effect. | [CSV](assets/data/simple_did_district.csv), [Stata](assets/data/simple_did_district.dta) |
| `staggered_did_district` | 40 districts adopt in Year 5, 40 in Year 6, and 80 are never treated. Effects vary across cohorts and time since adoption. | [CSV](assets/data/staggered_did_district.csv), [Stata](assets/data/staggered_did_district.dta) |
| `data_dictionary` | Variable names and descriptions. | [CSV](assets/data/data_dictionary.csv) |
| `workshop_estimates` | Model estimates and standard errors using the current datasets. | [CSV](assets/data/workshop_estimates.csv) |
| `csa_weighted_cells` | Five post-treatment estimates, weights, and contributions to Simple ATT. | [CSV](assets/data/csa_weighted_cells.csv) |
| `data_generation_summary` | District counts, years, and post-treatment periods by cohort. | [CSV](assets/data/data_generation_summary.csv) |
